claims.claim: Fiscal Q2 2027 revenue reached a record $2.739B, up 37% year over year, with data-center revenue growth accelerating to 46%, supporting continued AI-infrastructure demand.

factors.name: AI infrastructure exposure
factors.basis: Record revenue and accelerating data-center growth.

risks.risk: AI/custom-silicon demand can be concentrated in a limited set of hyperscale programs.

causalEdges.mechanism: larger AI systems require more compute, networking and interconnect silicon
causalEdges.falsifier: hyperscaler capex or Marvell design-win conversion weakens materially

unknowns.unknown: Customer-level concentration and security-level valuation are not established here.

claims.claim: Q2 FY2027 revenue was $39M above prior guidance midpoint; operating cash flow was $605.5M, giving concrete execution evidence beyond narrative.

factors.name: Execution versus expectations
factors.basis: Revenue exceeded guidance midpoint and cash generation remained substantial.

risks.risk: High AI expectations raise the future delivery bar.

causalEdges.mechanism: production ramps convert program wins into silicon revenue
causalEdges.falsifier: program delays or share loss prevent expected conversion

unknowns.unknown: No canonical live valuation input is asserted.
